snippet.title: The Dark Delivers Halloween Update Trailer [2026] [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
Welcome to Postal Sector 7. As the Night Shift Package Inspector, your job is simple: assess parcels and reject anything not up to code. Stay alert for anomalous dangers and survive long enough to meet your quota by 6AM.
 
Play the Halloween update on October 25th Featuring:
- Custom Night, tune monster difficulty
- Updated Packages, shapes, barcodes and logos
- Elevator Repair Shift, a new 3 night minigame

Free demo also available now

Play the Game here! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547920/The_Dark_Delivers/
